基于赛题提供的 CMU-MOSEI 数据，研究多模态特征提取、局部模态缺失下的情: This study uses the competition subset of CMU-MOSEI to investigate multimodal feature extraction, sentiment prediction under partial modality loss, and prediction explanations. RM-Net is fused with BERT LoRA text experts to predict sentiment polarity and intensity.
附件 1 的 100 条视频：特征提取、词级对齐及质量核验。: Attachment 1: feature extraction, word-level alignment and quality checks for 100 videos.
附件 2 的官方特征用于模型训练与评估；附件 3 的 30 条缺失样本用于专项预: Official features from Attachment 2 support training and evaluation; 30 incomplete samples from Attachment 3 receive predictions.
沿用问题二的冻结模型，计算模态归因与局部证据，形成附件 4 的 20 条样本解释: The frozen model from Problem 2 supports modality attribution and local evidence analysis for 20 samples in Attachment 4.
Android 应用支持文本、语音和视频输入，在设备本地计算情感极性与强度，并显: The Android application accepts text, audio and video, computes sentiment polarity and intensity on the device, and displays fusion parameters.
针对局部连续片段缺失，构建可靠性感知多模态网络，并融合 BERT LoRA 文本: A reliability-aware multimodal network and BERT LoRA text experts address missing contiguous segments. Classification and regression separately predict sentiment polarity and continuous intensity.
滑块表示固定融合公式中权重随文本可用比例的变化。: The slider shows how the fixed fusion weights vary with text availability.
报告冻结模型的总体性能、同协议候选比较及解释保真度。: Overall performance, candidate comparisons under the same protocol, and explanation fidelity are reported for the frozen model.
在相同数据划分与输入条件下比较 8 个代表性候选，包含多模态模型、纯文本专家与融: Eight representative candidates are compared on the same data split and input condition, including multimodal models, text-only experts and fusion models.
对 728 条验证样本实施联合遮挡，并与五次随机排序比较。所选位置具有较大的删除: Joint masking is evaluated on 728 validation samples against five random orderings. Selected positions have larger deletion effects; intensity retention does not outperform the random baseline.
附件 4 共 20 条样本，分别报告 8 个模态子集的预测、模态归因及文本位置证: For 20 samples in Attachment 4, the page reports predictions for eight modality subsets, modality attributions and text-position evidence.
Android 端情感分析应用，采用 RM + BERT LoRA 融合模型进行: An Android sentiment analysis application using RM + BERT LoRA fusion for on-device inference.
The application accepts individual or combined modalities and displays class scores, sentiment intensity and fusion information. The figures below document offline browser verification of version 2.2.1.
英文文本输入采用五种子 RM 与五个 LoRA 专家，并沿用冻结融合规则。: English text is processed by five RM seeds and five LoRA experts with the frozen fusion rules.
EmoMosaic：多模态特征提取与时序对齐、缺失鲁棒预测、模型解释及离线应用。: EmoMosaic: multimodal feature extraction and temporal alignment, prediction under missing modalities, model explanations and an offline application.
多模态情感预测：特征、模型与实验: Multimodal sentiment prediction: features, models and experiments
以附件 1 的原始视频和给定转写为输入，构建可追溯的三模态时序特征。: Raw videos and supplied transcripts in Attachment 1 are converted into traceable multimodal temporal features.
文本、语音与视觉具有不同的采样粒度，按序列位置直接拼接会产生时间对应误差。本问以: Text, audio and vision have different sampling granularities, so direct concatenation by sequence position can introduce temporal correspondence errors. Candidate word intervals define the alignment units, while numerical availability and timing quality are recorded separately.
全部 100 条样本及原始标签均予保留。预训练模型参数固定，标签不参与特征提取或: All 100 samples and their original labels are retained. Pretrained parameters remain fixed, and labels are not used for feature extraction or quality-threshold selection.
特征提取与时间质量控制并行进行，最终形成帧级、变长词级和定长接口三层表示。: Feature extraction and timing-quality control produce frame-level, variable-length word-level and fixed-length interface representations.
冻结 BERT 上下文特征，按原词对应的 WordPiece 均值池化。: Frozen BERT contextual features, mean-pooled over WordPieces associated with each original word.
韵律、音质、频谱、共振峰与倒谱特征。: Prosodic, voice-quality, spectral, formant and cepstral features.
27 项表情形变系数、3 项姿态及 5 项几何或动态指标。: 27 facial-expression coefficients, 3 pose measures and 5 geometric or dynamic measures.
L0 保留原始帧级特征与来源索引；L1 保存完整的变长词序列；L2 提供定长张量: L0 retains frame-level features and source indices; L1 stores complete variable-length word sequences; L2 provides fixed-length tensors and validity masks. Truncation at L2 does not alter the complete L0 and L1 records.
采用 wav2vec 2.0 的声学后验进行 CTC 强制对齐，估计候选词区间，: CTC forced alignment based on wav2vec 2.0 acoustic posteriors estimates candidate word intervals. Acoustic frames and valid face frames are pooled within the shared audio-video interval. Timing gates require word posterior and sample-mean posterior of at least 0.5, and transcript word error rate of at most 0.5.
词边界由 CTC 估计。低可信区间保留候选结果及来源索引，其跨模态使用由质量掩码: CTC estimates the word boundaries. Candidate intervals and source indices are retained for low-quality alignments, with cross-modal use restricted by quality masks.
通过时间门控的 1,316 个词来自 65 条样本；其余 610 个词保留特征，: The 1,316 words passing the timing gate come from 65 samples. Features for the remaining 610 words are retained while unreliable timing correspondence is masked. All 500 feature and mapping records agree across two independent extractions, with zero maximum numerical difference.
统计共同有效时长、词数、人脸检出、CTC 后验及不同时间粒度的信息保留率。: Distributions of shared duration, word counts, face detection, CTC posteriors and information retention at different temporal granularities.
在相同可信声学帧上，词级平均信息保留率为 0.2489，0.25 秒固定窗为 0: On the same trusted acoustic frames, mean information retention is 0.2489 for word intervals and 0.3120 for 0.25-second windows. Word-level organization provides semantic correspondence but does not maximize numerical information retention. Gate coverage and numerical consistency do not establish accuracy against manually annotated word boundaries.
自提取特征与附件 2 的官方特征分布不同。问题二、三使用官方对齐特征，本问的结果: The extracted features differ in distribution from the official features in Attachment 2. Problems 2 and 3 use the official aligned features; this stage concerns feature construction and quality verification.
局部连续缺失同时改变可用信息与观测分布。为保留三模态的原始对齐关系，模型保留缺失: Missing contiguous segments affect both available information and the observation distribution. Original positions are retained to preserve alignment; observation masks distinguish missing values, padding and genuine zeros, while visible modalities provide supplementary information.
采用赛题附件 2 的 aligned_50 官方特征，按 3,395 / 728: Official aligned_50 features from Attachment 2 are split into 3,395 training, 728 validation and 727 historical held-out samples. Features extracted in Problem 1 are verified separately and do not replace these inputs.
RM-Net 通过时序编码、跨模态注意力及可靠性门控建模，BERT LoRA 补: RM-Net uses temporal encoding, cross-modal attention and reliability gates; BERT LoRA provides task-specific text representations. Probabilities and intensities are averaged across five models within each branch.
原始观测与人工遮挡后的受损观测构成两个视图，共享 RM-Net 参数。联合目标包: The original observations and their artificially masked counterparts form two views sharing RM-Net parameters. The joint objective includes polarity and intensity supervision, feature reconstruction at artificially masked positions, and view-consistency constraints.
渐进式片段遮挡用于构造受损视图：训练前 30% 阶段将缺失率上限从 0.3 逐步: Progressive segment masking constructs the corrupted view: during the first 30% of training, the maximum missing rate rises from 0.3 to 1. Each draw selects 1–3 modalities and 1–2 contiguous intervals, with a 20% probability of retaining the original view.
渐进式片段遮挡作用于视图构造。原有缺失不作为重建目标，一致性分支采用停止梯度。: Progressive segment masking operates during view construction. Originally missing positions are excluded from reconstruction targets; the consistency branch uses stop-gradient.
固定验证集选择的融合参数，在清洁输入和 40% 混合缺失条件下评估同一模型。下表: The fusion parameters selected on the validation set are fixed for evaluation under clean input and 40% mixed missingness. Table values are read from the frozen evaluation records.
历史留出集两视图平均 Macro-F1 为 0.6446，较原 RM 辅助头提高: Mean Macro-F1 across the two historical held-out views is 0.6446, an increase of 0.0238 over the original RM auxiliary head. Final Macro-F1 remains below 0.70. Historical test results were observed during development, so this is not a new blind evaluation.
727 条历史留出样本，21 种缺失条件。分别比较相对 RM 辅助头的 Macr: Results cover 727 historical held-out samples and 21 missingness conditions. Gains denote Macro-F1 improvements over the RM auxiliary head and MAE reductions relative to the RM core.
冻结模型完成附件 3 全部 30 条样本的极性与强度预测。专项集缺少真值标签，因: The frozen model predicts polarity and intensity for all 30 samples in Attachment 3. Accuracy is not reported because this set has no ground-truth labels. Feature masking occurs after contextual encoding, so the findings do not directly extend to unavailable raw text.
沿用问题二的冻结预测器，分别解释情感强度与完整输入时的原预测类别概率。: The frozen predictor from Problem 2 is used to explain sentiment intensity and the probability of the class predicted from the complete input.
预测类别和连续强度由不同输出确定，二者的主要参考模态可能不同。本问固定两个解释目: Predicted class and continuous intensity are separate outputs and may depend on different modalities. Two explanation targets are fixed: modality-subset interventions quantify global effects, and position-wise masking identifies local evidence.
模型内部的门控权重用于描述 RM 路径，不能代替完整融合模型的类别归因。解释结果: Internal gates describe the RM computation path and do not replace class attribution for the complete fusion model. Explanations describe input dependence of the model rather than causes of human sentiment.
枚举文本、语音、视觉的全部 8 个子集，重新计算 RM 输出、LoRA 池化及文: All eight subsets of text, audio and vision are evaluated by recomputing RM outputs, LoRA pooling and text-availability weights. Exact Shapley values are then calculated. Intensity attribution uses empty-input intensity as its baseline; class attribution fixes the class predicted from the complete input.
F 分别表示融合强度或原预测类别概率。内部强度分解另行报告缩放后的三模态贡献、R: F denotes either fused intensity or the original predicted-class probability. A separate internal decomposition reports scaled modality contributions, the RM interaction term and the LoRA contribution.
对有效内容位置逐一遮挡。强度证据按输出绝对变化排序，分类证据按原预测类概率下降排: Valid content positions are masked individually. Intensity evidence is ranked by absolute output change; classification evidence is ranked by the decrease in the original predicted-class probability. PAD, CLS and SEP are excluded from ranking. Local effects include contextual and fusion-weight changes and are not additive.
证据通过字符偏移、CTC 候选词时间及原始帧号映射回文本、语音时段和视频帧。时间: Character offsets, candidate CTC word intervals and original frame indices map evidence back to text, audio intervals and video frames. Timing correspondence is verified separately, with unreliable mappings explicitly marked.
在 728 条验证样本上计算删除与保留曲线，并与五次随机排序比较。分类证据的归一: Deletion and retention curves are evaluated on 728 validation samples against five random orderings. Normalized deletion AUC for classification evidence increases by 0.1126, indicating a larger effect on the original predicted-class probability when selected positions are removed.
三模态同位干预。强度报告绝对变化，分类报告原预测类概率下降；随机曲线取五次排列的: The three modalities are intervened on at corresponding positions. Intensity uses absolute change; classification uses the decrease in the original predicted-class probability. Random curves average five orderings.
强度保留 AUC 高于随机，说明所选排序的删除影响并不等同于少量证据的充分性。分: Intensity-retention AUC exceeds the random baseline, so a larger deletion effect does not establish the sufficiency of a small evidence subset. Negative classification-retention AUC indicates a higher original-class probability, not higher accuracy.
另对 728 组样本实施整词删除与重新编码：与编码后遮挡相比，有符号效应的 Sp: Raw-word deletion with re-encoding is also evaluated on 728 pairs. Signed effects correlate with post-encoding masking at Spearman 0.6680 for intensity and 0.2903 for class probability. The interventions differ in context, positions and fusion weights and are not interchangeable.
附件 4 的 20 条样本均给出极性、强度、主要参考模态及证据定位。下图展示 1: All 20 samples in Attachment 4 include polarity, intensity, principal reference modalities and evidence locations. The figure presents word fragments, candidate audio intervals and visual keyframes for sample 19; source media support correspondence checks.
附件 4 的 19 号样本。橙色表示支持原预测类别，蓝色表示抵消；候选时间轴不等: Attachment 4, sample 19. Orange supports the original predicted class and blue opposes it; candidate timing is not manually annotated ground truth.
附件 4 没有真值标签，解释用于检查模型行为，不用于评估预测准确率。: Attachment 4 has no ground-truth labels. These explanations support model-behavior analysis rather than accuracy evaluation.

模型按需下载，输入与预测留在阅读者的电脑。首次完整运行约下载 254 MB；建议: Models download on demand; inputs and predictions stay on your computer. The first complete run downloads about 254 MB. A desktop browser is recommended; devices with limited memory may fail to load the model.
案例包含原始对齐语音与视觉特征，以及论文推理入口使用的 BERT 文本特征和词元: The example contains original aligned audio and visual features, along with the BERT features and token IDs used by the paper’s inference entry point. This sample has no ground-truth label.
使用同一 BERT 编码器与论文模型；语音、视觉按缺失处理。最多保留 48 个内: Uses the same BERT encoder and paper model, with audio and vision treated as missing. Up to 48 content tokens are retained, plus CLS and SEP.

模态选择作用于观测掩码。更改后点击重新计算；全部关闭时仅观察模型先验。: Modality selection changes the observation mask. Run again after changing the selection; disabling all modalities shows the model prior.

类别取融合概率最大项，强度由独立回归分支计算。概率未经独立校准；单个无标签案例用: The class is the largest fused probability; intensity comes from a separate regression branch. Probabilities are not independently calibrated. A single unlabeled example demonstrates inference and cannot measure accuracy.
输入超过 48 个内容词元，已按训练长度截断。: The input exceeds 48 content tokens and was truncated to the training length.
RM 分支集成种子 17、29、43、71、101 的五个模型；文本分支使用同一: The RM branch ensembles five models with seeds 17, 29, 43, 71 and 101. The text branch uses five LoRA adapters on a shared BERT base. Each branch averages class probabilities before availability-weighted fusion and the validation-frozen class bias.
f 为可见内容词元比例；UNK 不计入可用内容，PAD、CLS、SEP 不计入分: f is the visible fraction of content tokens. UNK is excluded from available content; PAD, CLS and SEP are excluded from the denominator. b = (0.25, 0, 0.025) for negative, neutral and positive classes. The BERT base uses FP16 storage with FP32 arithmetic; LoRA stays in FP32. See the validation record for differences from the paper’s Python entry point.
推理通过 Web Worker 中的 ONNX Runtime Web 执行，使: ONNX Runtime Web performs inference on your CPU in a Web Worker. Downloaded models are cached when browser storage is available; otherwise they can still run after downloading. Stop terminates the worker; Clear releases models and removes the current input.
完整三模态输入采用论文的 50 位置对齐特征。当前页面接受英文文本或已提取的对齐: Full three-modality input uses the paper’s 50-position aligned features. This page accepts English text or extracted aligned features. Raw audio/video must first be processed with the feature extraction method in Problem 1.
按位置展平的未标准化特征，维度为 768 / 74 / 35；缺失值与填充用零表: Unnormalized features flattened by position, with dimensions 768 / 74 / 35. Missing and padded values are zero.
文本、语音、视觉的观测掩码；填充位置必须为 false。: Observation masks for text, audio and vision; padding positions must be false.
JSON 文件上限为 3 MB。可下载案例输入查看完整结构；模型内部使用训练集统: JSON files are limited to 3 MB. Download the example input for the complete structure. The model normalizes and clips features using training-set statistics. The transcript is descriptive; inference uses numerical features and token IDs.
RM + BERT LoRA 的冻结结果。类别取概率最大项；本页展示预计算结果，: Frozen RM + BERT LoRA results. Class is the largest probability. This page displays precomputed results; samples have no ground-truth labels.

当文字、语音或视觉缺失一段，如何继续理解情感？EmoMosaic 将可靠性感知的: How can we understand sentiment when a span of text, audio or video is missing? EmoMosaic fuses reliability-aware RM-Net with BERT LoRA text experts, preserving temporal positions to predict sentiment polarity and intensity and explain each modality’s role.
100 条原始视频的词级对齐与质量核验。该辅助流程独立于预测模型使用的预提取特征: Word-level alignment and quality checks on 100 raw videos. This auxiliary pipeline is separate from the pre-extracted features used by the predictor.
使用 4,850 条预对齐片段训练与评估；通过连续片段遮挡研究局部缺失，并预测: Train and evaluate on 4,850 pre-aligned utterances, study local missingness with contiguous-span masks, and predict 30 unlabeled samples.
在冻结融合模型上计算八种模态组合的 Shapley 归因与位置遮挡效应，交互查看: Compute Shapley attributions over eight modality subsets and position-level occlusion effects on the frozen fused predictor. Explore 20 samples interactively.

局部连续缺失同时改变可用信息与观测分布。为保留三模态的原始对齐关系，模型保留缺失: Local contiguous missingness changes both the available information and the observation distribution. The model preserves temporal positions, uses observation masks to distinguish nonzero observations from missing positions, and reads complementary information from visible modalities. All-zero observations within the valid length are also treated as unobserved.
保留位置、更新观测掩码；跨模态注意力仅使用可见 key / value，整模态缺: Positions are preserved and observation masks updated. Cross-modal attention uses only visible keys and values; a fully missing modality receives zero gate weight.
历史留出集两视图平均 Macro-F1 为 0.6446，较原 RM 辅助头提高: The historical held-out two-view average Macro-F1 is 0.6446, an improvement of 0.0238 over the original RM auxiliary head. This split was inspected during development and is not a new blind test.
RM 门控、内部贡献与 Shapley 含义不同。编码后遮挡仍可能保留上下文；真: RM gates, internal contributions and Shapley values have different meanings. Encoded masking may retain context; the raw-word deletion check re-encodes text and maps surviving tokens back to their original positions. These explanations describe model dependence, not the real-world causes of sentiment.
